transcript: We have to learn how to mind our own business. What others standards are, it's not our business. What our expectations are, that is our business. The status quo is not the same. We have to be willing to allow people to be who they are and maneuver with that accordingly. It is not our job to manage and control others. Manage yourself, manage your expectations, manage what you're doing and allow other things to fall in alignment or not.
